current_default: CPU SCF density, energy-weighted density, DIIS residual Gram, and DIIS Fock extrapolation use build-time generated SCF TensorIR helpers; native CPU retains history mutation, metric normalization, augmented solve/retry and solver state. CUDA RHF/UHF/DF density, J/K, energy/force contractions and resident DIIS remain native; direct J/K host adapters in cuda/direct_jk.cpp remain native after leaving the CUDA-only source census
generated_capability: TensorIR owns general contractions/AD plus SCF density, energy-weighted density, DIIS Gram, and DIIS extrapolation equations. CPU production consumes checked build-time specializations with shape-independent equation hashes and preserves historical FP64 accumulation order.
missing_capability: CUDA integration of the same SCF equations remains open, especially circular live-history materialization, residual Gram execution, Fock extrapolation, and complete resident/ragged DIIS endpoint qualification. Metric normalization, dependent-history retirement and the augmented small solve remain explicit runtime/solver policy rather than TensorIR equations.
retirement_condition: Preserve generic solver/BLAS/runtime policy. CPU DIIS Gram/extrapolation scientific loops are retired by the generated cutover; retire the corresponding CUDA numerical regions only after compiler-owned execution passes independent RHF/UHF, inactive/wrapped/retired/ragged history, scratch-capacity, convergence and complete-endpoint gates. Serial DIIS remains the Direct/KS schedule and an explicit DF control until that qualification; cooperative DF retains a bounded warp fallback when partial scratch is unavailable.
